Joe Sproles, a James Island resident and Vietnam veteran, is continuing to give back to his community five decades after his military service. Joe started making handmade canes after seeing other veterans struggle to walk. Each one-of-a-kind cane goes to veterans around the Charleston area. Debbie highlighted that education is not one-size-fits-all, and quality education should not be limited to those who can afford it.

School choice empowers parents like Debbie to make sure their kids have the opportunity to succeed!
